시편 81:1.content: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of Asaph. Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

시편 81:2.content: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

시편 81:3.content: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

시편 81:4.content: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.

시편 81:5.content: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.

시편 81:6.content: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.

시편 81:7.content: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

시편 81:8.content: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

시편 81:9.content: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

시편 81:10.content: I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

시편 81:11.content: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.

시편 81:12.content: So I gave them up unto their own hearts’ lust: and they walked in their own counsels.

시편 81:13.content: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!

시편 81:14.content: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

시편 81:15.content: The haters of the Lord should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.

시편 81:16.content: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
